verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships Neo, a first-party agent that takes plain-English requests and handles dependencies, executes changes, and monitors outcomes (e.g. "Give me a VPC with a subnet in every AZ"). Its official MCP server also lets AI assistants such as Claude Code and Cursor query stacks, generate infrastructure code, and delegate tasks to Neo. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of Neo's natural-language command scope and controls (current evidence is mostly product-page marketing), and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice.
